They’re hidden from view as long as everyone is upstairs, but from the stairs themselves, whoever it is will have a pretty good view of them any second now. Buck coughs and says, “uh, s–so, gym,” and Eddie nods too many times, running a nervous hand through his hair. “Yeah, yeah, have fun,” he says, and starts walking backwards, vaguely towards the bunkroom. Maxwell, now downstairs, passes right between them and doesn’t even spare them a glance. ~ or: what if buck and eddie were secretly dating throughout the last three episodes of season 9?

Summary: Footsteps approach him and he tenses. "Buck." He doesn't have to turn around to know who it is. Eddie's frustrated sigh in response makes his lip twitch up on one side in satisfaction. "Just wanted to see if this," Eddie gestures between them. "Was going to be a problem." "Nope," Buck pops the 'p' in the word a bit louder than necessary. "No problem here, man." "Good," Eddie responds, folding his arms. "No problem here either."
